name: read
description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the workspace

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return; 0 means all remaining lines

name: write
description: Create or replace a file in the workspace

name: edit
description: Replace exactly one matching text fragment in a workspace file

edits.description: One edit object, an array of edit objects, or a JSON string containing either shape

oldText.description: Exact existing text to replace, kept for compatibility

name: ls
description: List one level of a workspace directory (read-only)

path.description: Workspace-relative directory to list; defaults to .

name: find
description: Find workspace files by glob pattern (read-only)

path.description: Workspace-relative directory or file to search; defaults to .

pattern.description: Relative glob pattern; supports recursive ** segments

name: grep
description: Search workspace file contents with a regular expression (read-only)

glob.description: Optional relative file glob; supports recursive ** segments

ignore_case.description: Match without case sensitivity; defaults to false

path.description: Workspace-relative directory or file to search; defaults to .

name: skill
description: Load a skill's instructions by name, or read a file inside that skill's directory. Call it before starting a task that matches a listed skill.

file.description: Optional relative path of a file inside the skill directory

name.description: Skill name from the available_skills listing

name: bash
description: Execute a shell command from the workspace
